company.name: ODWEN
company.description: Enabling India’s 60m Small & Medium Enterprises to find curated warehouses in minutes at prices below current market and transport their inventory in and out with just a few clicks.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform that allows customers to search, select, and book warehouse space and related services based on criteria like size, location, budget, and duration.
productsAndServices.name: On-Demand Warehouse Booking Platform

productsAndServices.description: A web-based warehouse management system that supports inventory tracking, barcode scanning, and real-time updates for consignments stored in partner warehouses.
productsAndServices.name: Warehouse Management System (WMS)

productsAndServices.description: Additional service allowing customers to book transport for picking up and moving inventory to and from warehouses, with options based on distance, goods nature, weight, and dimensions.
productsAndServices.name: Logistics and Transport Services

productsAndServices.description: A service to arrange insurance options for goods stored in warehouses, allowing customers to select appropriate coverage plans.
productsAndServices.name: Inventory Insurance Arrangement

productsAndServices.description: A service for warehouse owners to list their facilities on ODWEN’s platform, including site inspections, WMS provision, and operational training.
productsAndServices.name: Warehouse Partner Onboarding and Support

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,654,106 to $12,096,123, a 7.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 5 (-28).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include StoreHub, WarehouseOS, StoreKing.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
